column1: # TITLE: MicroRNA expression data from Bcl-xL silenced A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells
# SUMMARY: Bcl-xL is an anti-apoptotic protein that is frequently found to be overexpressed in non-small cell lung cancer leading to an inhibition of apoptosis and poor prognosis. Recently
column2: the role of miRNAs in regulating apoptosis and cell survival during tumorigenesis has become evident
column3: with cancer cells showing perturbed expression of various miRNAs. We utilized miRNA microarrays to determine if miRNA dysregulation in bcl-xL silenced lung adenocarcinoma cells could be involved in regulating apoptotic behavior
column4: and identified dysregulated miRNAs with putative targets involved in signal transduction pathways regulating apoptosis
